Native-safe GlyphIcon/DataFreshness/WidgetShell/Badge mirror the sibling parity widgets (BatteryCellsWidget/ChargePlansWidget). DataFreshness computes its relative time once at render (no 30s interval) to avoid a dangling timer under --detectOpenHandles; it is a Pressable(onRefresh) dot+label whose state is error>fetching>stale>fresh.

No DOM elements, react-i18next, lucide-react, framer-motion, Recharts, Leaflet, react-dom, or web UI-kit modules are imported into the native output — only React, RN primitives, the shared apps/native AppText/SemanticIcon/tokens, the native parity EmptyState/Skeleton, and the native parity useVehicles/useSettings hooks.
